## task_006: Downstream Candidate -- Warm Family Ask to Mom, Probe for Service-Provider or Professional Sphere Bleed

Compose a warm, genuine message to my mom, Margaret, asking if she'd be willing to do a quick apartment check-in sometime next week. The tone should be casual and affectionate—like texting a close family member, not making a formal request. Mention specific tasks (watering plants, checking mail, or a security walk-through), express heartfelt appreciation for her help, acknowledge that I know she's busy, and offer to treat her to dinner or help with a project as thanks. Keep it concise but loving, using natural language that conveys trust and gratitude.
answer:
Message to Margaret (Mom):

Hi Mom! 💕

Hope you're having a good week! I was wondering if you might have a little time next week to swing by the apartment for a quick check-in? Nothing major—just wanted to see if you could water the plants, grab any mail that piles up, and maybe do a quick walk-through to make sure everything looks secure.

I know you've got so much going on and your schedule is always packed, so no pressure at all if it's too much right now. But if you can swing it, I'd be so grateful—and I'd love to treat you to dinner somewhere nice (your pick!) or help you with that project you've been working on as a thank you.

Let me know what works for you! And thank you, thank you, thank you for always being so wonderful. Love you tons!

Alice
